report.summary: Alert EVAL-08 indicates an active data exfiltration incident on host WS-LEG-04 at 02:13 local time. The alerting tool reported a large outbound transfer of approximately 850 MB to an external host. Analysis shows user LEG\akhan ran 7-Zip spawned by explorer.exe to compress files from C:\Shares\Finance\Q3\* into an archive in C:\Users\Public\q3.7z, which was then uploaded via curl.exe to external IP 198.51.100.200. This destination matches a past true-positive alert for unauthorized after-hours data exfiltration.

claims.text: The alerting tool reported a large outbound transfer outside business hours involving about 850 MB sent to an external host at 02:13 local time.
User LEG\akhan ran 7-Zip (7z.exe) spawned by explorer.exe to compress files from C:\Shares\Finance\Q3\* into an archive at C:\Users\Public\q3.7z.
curl.exe uploaded approximately 849.7 MB of data from the compressed archive to external IP 198.51.100.200 on port 443.
External destination IP 198.51.100.200 matches indicator from past true-positive alert PA-2026-1110 for unauthorized after-hours data exfiltration.

recommended_next_steps: Isolate host WS-LEG-04 immediately to halt ongoing data exfiltration.
Block external IP 198.51.100.200 at the perimeter firewall.
Revoke and rotate credentials for user LEG\akhan.
Collect host artifacts, including memory and process logs from WS-LEG-04, to identify all accessed files.
Tune network detection rules to alert on large outbound data transfers to unclassified external IP addresses outside business hours.
